description: Retrieve recorded attributes for an AphiaID or canonical WoRMS LSID, including inherited attributes by default. Resume nextResultOffset as resultOffset with unchanged selectors and options. Whole rows retain original preorder nodeIndex and parentIndex across pages; parents may be on earlier pages. measurementType keeps each matching node with its subtree and ancestors, indices unchanged; totalCount counts that set and unfilteredCount the whole tree. Values, references and inheritance markers remain unchanged; on an accepted taxon WoRMS also returns attributes recorded on its synonyms whatever includeInherited is set to, marked by inheritedFrom. A notice names the linked accepted ID, distinguishing an accepted alternative representation from its preferred ID. Missing traits do not prove biological absence; IUCN list membership is not a threat category.

anyOf.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

aphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID, decimal string, or canonical urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:<AphiaID>; outputs remain numeric.

includeInherited.description: Include attributes inherited from higher taxa; default true.

measurementType.description: Case-insensitive whole-value measurement type, not trimmed, e.g. Body size; blank means no filter. Names come from worms_list_reference with topic: trait_types.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based local position; resubmit unchanged selectors and options.

name: worms_get_traits

aphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

budgetLimited.description: Whether the byte budget ended this local page early.

measurementType.description: Effective measurementType filter with its original value.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400/422 rejected the inputs. `upstream_rate_limited`: Upstream rate limit or local queue overflow. `upstream_access_denied`: Keyless upstream denies access. `upstream_unavailable`: Network, server, or HTML failure. `upstream_timeout`: Request or whole-tool deadline expired. `invalid_upstream_response`: Malformed or incompatible upstream response. `response_too_large`: Upstream response exceeds 8 MiB. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextResultOffset.description: Next local position; null when consumed.

notice.description: Linked accepted/preferred-AphiaID and absent-attribute guidance, in that order.

oversizedItem.description: One indivisible scientific item exceeds the target; retained intact with forward progress.

requiredBytes.description: Serialized paired-surface result bytes for an oversized item, excluding transport-added metadata.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based starting position in the complete local sequence.

returnedCount.description: Whole scientific items returned on this segment.

statusError.description: Failed taxonomic-status read; evidence is unaffected, but whether the AphiaID is its accepted name is unknown.

totalCount.description: Known local sequence length before pagination.

traits.description: This preorder segment; indices refer to the complete original tree.

items.description: Trait evidence node with complete topology; omitted or null facts are unknown.

inheritedFrom.description: Known different source taxon (a higher taxon or a synonym), otherwise null.

measurementValue.description: Unmodified recorded value; no inferred units.

parentIndex.description: Immediate parent index; null at roots.

parentType.description: Immediate parent measurement type; null at roots.

unfilteredCount.description: Nodes in the complete tree before the measurementType filter.
